report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms durations; logs, traces, and metrics show no errors (502 count is 0), no pool exhaustion (pool size/idle=1), and no Redis or downstream timeouts. The alert observations are healthy and contradict any fault hypothesis. Deployment record only establishes gateway v1.0.0 with no prior version. No current evidence substantiates a bounded root cause; hand off for baseline/SLO context and longer-window trends.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency SLO/threshold for /v1/checkout to determine whether 63-94ms is anomalous
Longer-window latency trend for /v1/checkout to detect degradation over time
Downstream service (order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis) latency metrics to attribute any slowness
Error-rate or saturation metrics for gateway and dependencies beyond the 60s window
